Anna (Docs): heads up — i've opened a docs PR to patch the outage notes and add a short SDK fallback snippet. need 2 reviewers + green docs preview before merging today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4876 :hourglass:
Raj P: linking the incident here: INC-1420 — please include the statuspage link and the timeline summary. also add the short-term workaround we told support to use.
Miguel S: putting the SDK example below. keep it tiny and copy-pastable.
Miguel S: ```python
# fallback: try hosted, then dedicated endpoint
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
try:
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
except Exception as e:
    client = RedwoodClient(endpoint="https://dedicated.example")
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
print(resp.text)
```
Elena (Engineering): quick note — docs preview is timing out on the preview builder (we hit the assets timeout on large code blocks). might need to reduce embedded examples or inline them.
CI Bot: docs-preview failed — error: "asset-bundle-timeout: 120s". retry? :warning:
Raj P: we should still include the statuspage link and the exact workaround steps (cli + curl). keep examples concise.
Anna (Docs): good call. i'm trimming the large snippet and adding a short curl example + link to the full example in the SDK repo (to avoid preview bloat). also adding a Known Issues section and the statuspage link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1420
Tom (PM): add a 1-line note about impact (auth tokens failing for some customers) and that engineering has a mitigation live. stakeholders will ask.
SRE - Priya: confirm mitigation: rotating the auth proxy fixed retries for 98% of requests; include that as "temporary mitigation" not a permanent fix.
docs-bot: preview available at https://docs-preview.internal/pr-4876 — note: images trimmed for faster build.
Anna (Docs): @Raj P @Miguel S can you two review? will hold merge until preview is green. aiming for merge at 18:00 PT if CI passes.
Raj P: reviewing now. focusing on accuracy of timeline + status link.
Miguel S: LGTM on content. suggested minor wording for the sdk snippet to mention exponential backoff.
Elena (Engineering): i pushed a tiny change to the build config to increase asset timeout to 180s — redeploying preview builder.
CI Bot: retry started — build queued.
Anna (Docs): if preview still fails after retry, plan B: merge a minimal patch with the statuspage link + Known Issues and follow up with the expanded SDK example as a separate PR.
Tom (PM): agree — do minimal first, follow-up SDK sample ok.
CI Bot: build succeeded — preview available: https://docs-preview.internal/pr-4876/preview :tada:
Anna (Docs): great — thanks everyone. merging after a final quick check and leaving a follow-up issue for the larger sample. I'll add a short NOTE in the PR description that support and SRE have the full workaround steps.
Raj P: quick nit: in the Known Issues block, change "workaround applied" to "temporary mitigation applied".
Anna (Docs): done. merging now. will post an update to #support and ping SRE + support docs. :white_check_mark:
SRE - Priya: confirmed, will add the rollback/playbook snippet to internal runbook and link from the follow-up PR.
Anna (Docs): thread closed after merge. thanks all!
